text: DSH Side Chat（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在主对话旁开启带有当前上下文的独立侧边讨论。它通过 /side、主对话输入区按钮或选中文字操作接入 DSH 右侧栏，并沿用原生会话界面。可分别选择模型与权限，附加文件和图片，创建目标、审核计划、压缩对话并导出记录，也能同时打开多个讨论。适合在不中断主会话的情况下追问、比较方案或检查内容。需要 DSH Desktop 及 dsh-delete-session 配合完成关闭清理；无需额外 API 密钥。

DSH Side Chat adds contextual side chats to DSH Web. Open with /side or selected text; each uses the native sidebar and independent model and permissions. Attach files, manage goals, review plans, compact or export, and keep discussions open. Cleanup needs DSH Desktop and dsh-delete-session.
想在主对话旁边开一个保留当前上下文的独立讨论。
DSH 有没有类似 /side 的方式让我边做任务边追问？
我想选中聊天里的一段文字，直接拿去侧边提问。
能不能同时开几个互不影响的侧边会话？
我想给临时讨论单独换模型和权限设置。
需要在 DSH 里为另一个方案建目标、看计划并导出讨论记录。
I want a separate side conversation that starts with the context of my current DSH chat.
Can I ask about a selected passage without derailing the conversation I am working on?
I need several side discussions with their own model and permission choices.
DSH Side Chat 的功能「上下文侧边讨论」：在有内容的主对话中输入 /side 或点击输入区按钮，即可在右侧开启独立讨论；新会话继承打开时的上下文，后续消息保留在侧边会话。
DSH Side Chat 的功能「选中文字提问」：在主对话中选中一段文字后点击浮出的提问按钮，插件会把引用内容带入新开的侧边讨论，便于围绕具体段落追问。
DSH Side Chat 的功能「独立会话控制」：在侧边会话中选择模型与权限，并使用原生会话输入、文件附件、目标和计划模式处理这条讨论。
DSH Side Chat 的功能「压缩与导出」：通过侧边会话操作菜单压缩当前对话，或下载包含该侧边讨论新增消息和附件的 ZIP 记录。

dsh-side-chat README · 功能：| 功能 | 你可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **带上下文的追问** | 打开时界面为空，模型保留主对话上下文；也可选中文字，直接在侧边询问。 |
| **独立的模型与权限** | 使用 DSH 原生选择器切换模型、推理等级和权限，设置仅作用于当前侧边对话。 |
| **原生附件与引用** | 沿用主对话的文件、图片和 `@` 引用能力，为当前副本添加参考材料。 |
| **目标与计划** | 创建、编辑、暂停或继续目标；进入计划模式，在侧边审核模型提交的计划。 |
| **多标签对话** | 同时保留多个侧边讨论，分别处理不同问题。 |
| **临时会话不占列表** | 侧边临时对话不进入左侧会话列表，也不会出现在列表搜索结果中。 |
| **时间、用量与导出** | 查看原生消息时间、token 用量和执行过程，使用原生压缩与日志下载。 |
| **关闭后清理** | 没发过消息时直接清理；开始聊天后再确认删除。清理会话文件、索引、缓存、草稿和独占附件。 |

dsh-side-chat README · 熟悉的 DSH 操作：侧边初始页显示 DSH 原生标志和上下文提示；发送第一条消息后，进入正常聊天界面。

聊天内容和输入框直接使用 DSH 原生组件。点击 **＋**，与主对话相同的文件、目标、计划、反馈、压缩、权限、模型和日志下载都在这里；具体项目随 DSH 原生功能而定。

dsh-side-chat README · 安装：> [!IMPORTANT]
> 当前完整支持 **Windows · DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5`**。请先按 [dsh-delete-session 的安装说明](https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-delete-session#安装)安装并启用删除服务，再安装本插件。该服务负责关闭后的永久清理，安装过程包含它所需的桌面程序适配。

在 PowerShell 中执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-side-chat/releases/download/v0.2.4/dsh-side-chat-0.2.4.tgz
```

**重启 DSH，在已有聊天内容的主对话输入 `/side`。** 全新且未聊天的主对话不提供此命令。发行包已预构建，无需在本机编译。
dsh-side-chat README · 安装：如果已启用其他插件的 `/side` 功能，请先停用同名入口，避免命令冲突。其他 DSH 版本、独立 Web 部署及其他操作系统尚未完成端到端验证。

dsh-side-chat README · 1. 打开侧边对话：在**主对话输入框**输入：

```text
/side
```

也可以直接带上问题：

```text
/side 解释一下刚才这个方案的取舍，还有哪些替代方案？
```

选中主对话中的一段文字，点击 **「在侧边对话中询问」**，即可围绕选中的内容继续讨论。

dsh-side-chat README · 2. 按当前问题选择工具：- 点击输入框下方的模型或权限控件，设置当前侧边对话。
- 点击 **＋ → 文件**，添加文件或图片；其他引用沿用主对话的 `@` 入口。
- 点击 **＋ → 目标** 管理长期目标，或通过 **＋ → 计划** 进入、退出计划模式。
- 点击侧边顶部的 **＋**，再开一个独立讨论。

dsh-side-chat README · 3. 保留结果，再关闭：需要留存时，先点击 **＋ → 下载日志**。没有发送过新消息的侧边对话会直接关闭并清理，包括只输入了草稿的情况。已开始聊天时，选择 **「删除并关闭」** 会停止侧边活动并清理数据；选择取消则继续保留。

临时对话不会加入左侧列表。窗口刷新或 DSH 重启后，插件会通过已登记的临时身份回收遗留副本，避免留下找不到入口的会话。

dsh-side-chat README · 常见问题：
会改变主对话或其他侧边对话吗？ 侧边使用新的会话 ID，消息、目标、计划和权限绑定当前副本，已打开主对话的内容和选择不会被切换。复制的是打开时的历史与上下文，包括此前仍适用的用户指令；不额外注入“侧边对话”模式。原生控件的偏好保存规则与 DSH 本身一致。 界面只显示打开后新增的消息，聊天导航与轨迹也遵循这个显示起点。继承的记录仍保留在临时副本中，供模型使用；打开后主对话新增的内容不会自动同步进来。
为什么关闭时提示删除失败？ 请确认 [dsh-delete-session](https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-delete-session#安装) 已按其文档完成安装，并在同一个 `desktop` profile 中启用。删除没有成功时，面板会保留，方便处理后重试。

dsh-side-chat README · 常见问题：
下载的日志包含哪些内容？ 使用 DSH 原生的日志导出，范围是当前副本，包含复制进来的主对话历史；不会导出其他独立侧边的后续消息。分享前请自行检查内容。
关闭会删除我添加的项目文件吗？ 会话清理会保留你引用的项目文件和共享数据，清理的是该侧边对话的消息及相关独占数据。确认删除后，对话内容无法通过本插件恢复。
可以从 npm 或 GitHub 源码直接安装吗？ 目前请使用上方的 **GitHub Release 预构建包**。主分支存放开发源码，直接安装 GitHub 主分支不会自动生成运行文件。自行构建的步骤见 [开发文档](docs/development.md)。

dsh-side-chat README · 反馈与贡献：遇到问题时，请在 [Issues](https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-side-chat/issues) 提供 DSH 版本、插件版本、复现步骤及相关截图；日志请先确认不含敏感内容。

欢迎提交改进。[开发文档](docs/development.md)包含构建、验证与代码入口，[更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)列出各版本变化。

dsh-side-chat README · 致谢与许可：侧边对话核心提取自 [Better Sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)，交互参考 Codex `/side`。感谢上游项目。

dsh-side-chat README · DSH Side Chat：

dsh-side-chat README · DSH Side Chat：[简体中文](README.md) · **English** [Features](#features) · [Install](#install) · [Usage](#usage) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) Your main chat is implementing a feature, but you want to understand a design choice, inspect some code, or explore another approach. Enter `/side` to open an independent conversation beside it, with the context captured when it opens.

dsh-side-chat README · DSH Side Chat：Each side chat has its own messages, model and permissions. Attach reference files, discuss a plan, or keep several side conversations open at once.

Temporary side chats stay out of the left conversation list and its search results. Confirmed close removes their session files, indexes, caches, drafts and exclusive attachments. Referenced project files and shared data remain intact. Registered abandoned copies are reclaimed after a window reload or DSH restart.

dsh-side-chat README · DSH Side Chat：**A clean transcript with the context preserved.** Side chats display only messages added after opening, while the model retains the main chat's context at that point. Timestamps, token usage, streaming, the composer and command menus continue to use DSH's native components.

dsh-side-chat README · Features：| Feature | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| **Contextual follow-ups** | Open with an empty transcript and the main chat's context, or select a passage to ask about it. |
| **Independent models and permissions** | Use native DSH controls to choose the model, reasoning effort and permission preset for this side chat. |
| **Native attachments and references** | Use the same file, image and `@` reference features as the main chat. |
| **Goals and plans** | Create, edit, pause and resume goals; enter plan mode and review the submitted plan in the side panel. |
| **Multiple tabs** | Keep separate discussions open for different questions. |
| **Timestamps, usage and export** | See native message times, token usage and execution details; use native compaction and log export. |
| **Temporary conversations** | Confirm before permanently deleting a side chat. Download its logs first if you want to keep a copy. |

dsh-side-chat README · Native DSH controls：The transcript and composer use the actual native components. The **＋** menu follows the main chat, including files, goals, plans, feedback, compaction, permissions, models and log export, as provided by your DSH installation.
dsh-side-chat README · Native DSH controls：

dsh-side-chat README · Native DSH controls：
Review plans in context

Read the proposed plan, approve it, or leave feedback and keep planning.

 Confirm before cleanup

Cancel to keep the conversation. Failed deletion retains the panel so you can retry.

dsh-side-chat README · Install：> [!IMPORTANT]
> The complete supported setup is **Windows · DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5`**. First install and enable [dsh-delete-session](https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-delete-session#安装) using its documented setup, including the required Desktop application adaptation. It provides permanent cleanup when a side chat closes.

Run in PowerShell:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-side-chat/releases/download/v0.2.4/dsh-side-chat-0.2.4.tgz
```

dsh-side-chat README · Install：**Restart DSH, then enter `/side` in a main chat with existing messages.** The command is unavailable in a fresh empty conversation. This prebuilt package requires no local compilation.

Disable another `/side` provider before enabling this one. Other DSH versions, standalone Web deployments and operating systems have not completed end-to-end validation.

dsh-side-chat README · Usage：Enter either command in the **main chat composer**:

```text
/side
```

```text
/side Explain the tradeoffs in that approach. What alternatives should I consider?
```

You can also select text in the main transcript and choose **Ask in side chat**.

dsh-side-chat README · Usage：- Use the model and permission controls beneath the side-chat input to configure that conversation.
- Use **＋ → File** to attach files or images, and the native `@` entry point for references.
- Use **＋ → Goal** to manage a goal, or **＋ → Plan** to enter or leave plan mode.
- Use **＋** in the side-panel header to start another side chat.
- Use **＋ → Download logs** before closing if you want to retain the results.

dsh-side-chat README · Usage：The empty side page shows DSH’s native brand mark and a context hint. A side chat with no new messages closes and cleans up directly, including draft-only input. After a message is sent, **Delete and close** confirms permanent cleanup; cancelling keeps it open.

dsh-side-chat README · FAQ：**Does this change the main chat?** The copy has a new Session ID and its own messages, goals, plans and permissions. The open main chat's content and selections remain independent. The fork inherits the existing history and applicable user instructions, without an extra side-chat boundary prompt. Native preference-saving rules follow DSH itself.

dsh-side-chat README · FAQ：**Why does closing fail?** Check that dsh-delete-session is installed and enabled in the same `desktop` profile. Failed cleanup keeps the panel open for retry.

**What is exported?** Native DSH export targets this copy, including its inherited main-chat history. Other independent side chats' subsequent messages are excluded. Inspect the contents before sharing.

dsh-side-chat README · FAQ：**Are my project files deleted?** Referenced project files and shared data are retained. Cleanup removes the side conversation and its exclusively owned data.

**Can I install from npm or the GitHub main branch?** Use the prebuilt GitHub Release above. The main branch contains development source and does not automatically build runtime files during installation. See the [development guide](docs/development.md) to build locally.

dsh-side-chat README · Feedback and contributions：[Open an issue](https://github.com/qiaozheng9/dsh-side-chat/issues) with the DSH and plugin versions, reproduction steps and relevant screenshots. Check logs for sensitive information before sharing them.

See the [development guide](docs/development.md) for build and validation commands, and the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for release history.
